findings.detail: The ordinary authored callback evidence is kept distinct from cm_crash and postclaim cr_handler fatal-handler entries, the frozen volatile consumer, native frame reads, and dependency/stack/publication limitations.

Full int64 fixture token preservation is not native int descriptor provenance. Checked native ABI conversions, descriptor/path custody and immediate native error capture are requirements, not established facts. Synthetic refusal and caller-entry errno policy remain separate.

Reached-only callback checks and return-domain validation can halt after successful OPEN without compensating CLOSE. Stable complete reachable callbacks and valid conversion contracts are prerequisites; no second admission, cleanup/reset or inferred descriptor recovery is introduced.

The single native blame write and unconditional subsequent sync/close after ordinary return match the engine branch sequence. Separate retrying sig_write is not substituted. Ordinary completion, failure/short-write receipts, durable file contents and closed-descriptor custody remain distinct.

Fixture canonical ID syntax is broader than SDK cm_id_ok. The foobar-to-foo example is expressly conditional source reasoning, depends on a matching startup g_cm record and successful relevant operations, and does not assert observed I/O, loading, causation or a permitted quarantine change.
The void callback cannot separately establish live-mod, clock, open, write, sync or close outcomes. CM_CRASHES/CM_BLAME startup policy is excluded from any proposed ordinary witness.

The proposed next slice is a source-only ordinary-file custody plan. A later disposable-file witness remains contingent on explicit ABI, binding, file/descriptor ownership, raw/error capture, stable arguments, no-retry close uncertainty, fresh process/file identities and external cleanup custody; no adapter or native execution is authorized here.

The helper contains no child-command, compiler, callback, loader, device or prior-suite invocation. It reads pinned local bytes through nofollow directory descriptors, rejects duplicate/conflicting input names, creates fresh private output exclusively, closes regular-file inventory, and publishes an origin-free projection only after successful retention.
